result:
PR #429 is open. Summary of what was done:

**Investigated first, then closed 2 genuine gaps out of the 4 findings** (the dispatch had 2 duplicate finding-pairs):

1. **Duplicate Work Detection** (tasks table) — confirmed via `loop-prevention.ts`'s own header comment that this was genuinely unbuilt. Added `task-dedup-service.ts` (a sibling to `capability-registry-service.ts`, reusing the same embeddings infra with its own `'task'` entity type), wired into task create/update, plus a manager-gated scan API and a new `/task-duplicates` page.

2. **Duplicate Data Detection** — found this was **largely already resolved**: `mdm-quality-service.ts` (Wave 93) already generalizes dedup for customers/suppliers with a full scan/review/merge workflow, not built on `reconciliation-engine.ts` as the finding assumed. The one real gap — purchase invoices had only an ephemeral exact-match helper with no persistent workflow — was closed by extending that same service/UI with a 3rd entity type.

No schema migration needed. Verified with a fresh `bun install`: tsc clean, lint clean, 1424/1424 tests pass, build succeeds, and all 5 governance checks (guardrail presence, asset registry, metadata index, doc quarantine, doc cross-reference) pass. Registered the claim in `ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml` before starting, didn't touch `permission-service.ts`, and left the PR unmerged for audit per Rule 7(c)/10.

PR: https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/429
